visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a white dress holds a baby in front of a vibrant Mexican altar decorated with orange marigolds and skeletons. The background shows tropical palm trees and buildings under a bright blue sky. (2) Silver and white skeleton decorations are seen hanging from outdoor structures, some shaped like angels, surrounded by hundreds of suspended marigold flowers and fairy lights. (3) The woman walks through a sunlit courtyard with a stroller; more floral decorations hang from a stylized bare tree in a large stone pot. (4) Transition to a clear blue swimming pool where the woman and baby play with a colorful inflatable ring and a beach ball. (5) A montage follows showing various Day of the Dead altars featuring candles, photos, and monkey statues, as well as 'Pan de Muerto' bread displayed in baskets. (6) Performers in elaborate skeleton face paint and colorful floral dresses parade through a resort or restaurant area. (7) The video concludes with the woman holding the baby while walking along a path lined with cacti and resort villas, ending with a cheerful selfie of the woman wearing sunglasses and a sun hat.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a family's travel experience in Mexico during the Day of the Dead. It aims to showcase the festive atmosphere of Los Cabos and encourage parents that international travel with a baby is achievable and enjoyable with proper planning.
